biotools.summary: tstrait is an open-source Python library for simulating quantitative traits on ancestral recombination graphs (ARGs). It addresses the limitation of existing methods by directly simulating traits on ARGs, avoiding genotype data export and enabling analysis of biobank-scale datasets.
